title: Spec018 residual readiness evidence for F09 H06 H10 H11

phases.objective: Classify F09 attestation parity, H06 security review, H10 staging verification, and H11 release readiness independently without migration execution, grants, provider calls, runtime transitions, or Production promotion.

e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: A complete synthetic report is ready for review but remains explicitly unauthorized for Production promotion or runtime transition activation.
steps: Build the report from exact-SHA, attestation, registry, security-control, staging, and rollback inputs.
Classify absent or incomplete evidence as blocked for the specific requirement.
Verify the security matrix covers authentication, authorization, object scope, replay, injection, path traversal, and secret exposure.
Verify F09 remains shadow-only and H10/H11 preserve no-mutation and no-promotion boundaries.
assertions: H06 requires explicit evidence references and zero unresolved findings for every control.
H10 requires exact main SHA, CI, staging reachability, clean readback, and runtime-integrity evidence.
H11 requires release-readiness, rollback, and staging evidence while Production promotion remains false.
The report contains no secrets and performs no migrations, grants, database mutations, provider calls, or runtime transitions.
